flows.title: Invite someone to a project
steps: Open the project and click Share in the top bar.
Enter one or more email addresses, or workspace groups on Business and Enterprise plans, in the Add people field.
Choose the access level: Admin for everything including project settings and integrations, Editor to build and edit, or Viewer for read-only access to the editor.
Click Invite. Each person gets an email with a link, and the project also appears in their Shared with me section if they already use Lovable.

flows.title: Make a preview link for a reviewer
steps: Open the project, click Share, and select Share preview.
Give it a Link name that says who it is for, such as Client review — each active link in a project needs its own name — and choose whether to Allow comments.
Click Create preview link. Lovable copies the URL to your clipboard, and it can be copied again later from Your active links.
A preview link is view-only: it shows the latest in-progress version of the app and grants no access to the editor, the chat or the source code.

flows.title: Switch or create the branch Lovable syncs
steps: Open Project settings, then Git, then GitHub.
Click the branch picker and search or select the branch you want. Clicking it switches Lovable to editing and syncing that branch.
To make a new one, click the branch picker and click Create branch at the bottom of the list, then enter a name — Lovable checks it against empty names, invalid characters and duplicates.
The new branch starts from whichever branch is active, not the repository's default, so switch to main first if that is where it should come from.
Lovable edits and syncs one branch at a time, and neither switching nor creating works while it is editing the project.
